<div class="card-body">
'''A Few Maneuvers''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Used Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">敵のかわし方</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">このターンの間、好きな宇宙戦闘機の航行速度と回避値を＋2する（宇宙船の回避値を目標にした運命数を引いた際、引き終わった後にこのカードを使って、結果を左右することもできる）。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-70o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「敵のかわし方なら心得てる。やつらをまくぜ」帝国軍の砲火をくぐり、ハイパースペース突入までの時間をかせぐには、強化したシールドと巧みな操縦技術が不可欠である。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' How to dodge the enemy.

'''Card text:''' For the remainder of this turn, add 2 to hyperspeed and maneuver of any starfighter. After a destiny draw targeting a starship's maneuver, this card may still change the result.

'''Lore:''' “I know a few maneuvers. Shake them.” Boosted shields and fancy flying are needed to last until the jump to hyperspace.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[A Few Maneuvers]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
